specialties.name: Tax authorities' own AI
specialties.description: Tax authorities use AI to pick audits, screen fraud, answer taxpayers and work their cases.

specialties.name: Facing tax audits, notices and disputes
specialties.description: Taxpayers use AI to anticipate audit flags, answer notices and audit queries, and argue disputes.

specialties.name: Real-time reporting and e-invoicing
specialties.description: Invoices and transactions reported to authorities as they happen, replacing periodic returns.

specialties.name: Global minimum tax (Pillar Two)
specialties.description: Collecting data, computing, filing and correcting the new global minimum tax across every jurisdiction.

specialties.name: Rule engines do the tax math
specialties.description: AI reads facts and rules, while a deterministic engine computes the tax exactly and auditably.

specialties.name: Tax when AI agents act
specialties.description: Tax engines and rules adapting to AI agents that buy, file or answer for taxpayers.
